description: Changes ONE group of the advanced settings of a campaign: protected access (blacklist, whitelist, email verification, single lead limit), WordPress integration, the additional host and support lists, which existing page the registration, thank-you, live, replay or closed view uses, the field names an autoresponder expects, or the wording of the privacy checkbox. Side effect: it writes on the connected WordPress site, a member entry also CREATES A WORDPRESS USER with access, and a changed page link moves where participants land; everything else on the campaign stays. Needs `session_id`, `webinar_id`, `group`, `settings` and a clear yes (`confirm` true). Only the group you pass changes, and an unknown key refuses that whole group. Read the current state with wi_get_webinar_settings first and say what will change before you write.

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said what may change, including any user this creates.

group.description: Which group to change. One group per call.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

settings.description: The fields of that group with their new values, as wi_get_webinar_settings names them. Only passed keys change.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_change_advanced_settings
title: Change access, users or page routing of a webinar
